PLAN "12-Week Upper-Body Rehab-Friendly Strength for Climbers"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "pain-free upper-body strength & climbing-specific control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundational (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper mobility & scapular control":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Horizontal push/pull & rotator cuff-friendly":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 6m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pull emphasis, volume control":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 6m
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 6m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Scapular stability & controlled pressing":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x35..50 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Horizontal strength & rotator health":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds

      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull focus & eccentric control":

    WEEK 3:
